title: Old Fashioned Rich Portuguese Chicken Casserole
description: A rich and molten Portuguese dish featuring chicken, treacle, and bhuna spices, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and can be served in a ramekin, making it a great option for a Buddhist temple gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
In a separate bowl, mix together the treacle, bhuna spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the treacle mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a greased 6 cup ramekin, create a layer of potato slices.
Add a layer of the chicken mixture on top of the potatoes.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of potatoes on top.
Pour the chicken broth over the top of the casserole.
Cover the ramekin with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
